t: The Bristan Cinnamon Easyfit monobloc sink mixer is a contemporary single lever kitchen tap designed for efficient water control. Ideal for professional kitchen fitters and busy plumbers, this deck-mounted brass tap simplifies installation with its innovative top-fixing Easyfit base. The smooth swivel spout provides flexible reach across the sink, while the durable ceramic cartridge ensures precise water flow control. Supplied with flexible tails and isolation valves, this polished chrome mixer combines reliable daily performance with a modern aesthetic, making it a practical choice for any domestic kitchen upgrade.
